control_failures.control_label: identification of every energy source for the task
parking, chocking and restraint of equipment

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: prohibition notice - work stopped during start-up after maintenance on P-3223

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ENERGY_SOURCE_IDENTIFICATION: the identification of every energy source for the task was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the identification of every energy source for the task on P-3223, M-3223 and PT-3223 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and permitting an isolation, specifically authorising a group isolation. P-3223 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the identification of every energy source for the task was in place but did not perform. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 20 April 2005 a regulatory notice was issued concerning P-3223, M-3223 and PT-3223 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility following start-up after maintenance.
